description: Save what this task has established. Each collection is independent: an item that fails does not discard the others, and each one is reported separately. Omission preserves what is already saved. Saving does not finish the task. Collections are optional arrays. Each write must carry at least one item in a nonempty collection or a non-null scalar value; controls alone save nothing. A rejected item blocks COMPLETE delivery: resend it under its collection; an accepted version of the same item supersedes the rejected proposal, not a proof that its old scientific claim was corrected. Use a different item identity for an additional fact. Choose disposition PARTIAL to stop with unresolved writes; the host records them in the delivery without marking them repaired.

coverage.description: Save the evidenced scope assessment of one document listed in documents. Identity: document_revision_id. An item sent again with the same document_revision_id replaces the saved one; to change the document_revision_id of a saved item, quote its item_id. No other id is needed. status: EXAMINED, NO_EXPERIMENTAL_DETAILS, PARTIAL, UNAVAILABLE.

document_revision_id.description: A document revision as documents lists it.

explanation.description: What was inspected for the assigned task and what remains unread or unresolved. Do not claim the rest of a document is irrelevant merely because this task's assigned scope is settled.

item_id.description: Host-issued handle returned when this item was first saved; quote it only to change the fields that identify the item (its collection says which), and omit it for a new item.

selection_ids.description: Optional source selections from this document for your assessment.

status.description: Your assessment of the assigned document scope. Reading and citation counts are activity records and do not determine this scientific statement.

limitations.description: Save one limitation. Identity: scope. An item sent again with the same scope replaces the saved one; to change the scope of a saved item, quote its item_id. No other id is needed.

item_id.description: Host-issued handle returned when this item was first saved; quote it only to change the fields that identify the item (its collection says which), and omit it for a new item.

reason.description: Why this scope could not be completed from the sources.

scope.description: The exact id this limitation covers, copied as the task sheet or progress gives it: a reaction_block_id, compound_id, document_revision_id or selection id.

selection_ids.description: Selections evidencing the limitation, when any.

paragraphs.description:
Deliver a complete paragraph with its role and object ownership,
    without extracting isolated scientific values. Identity: selection_ids (the item's own content). An item sent again with the same selection_ids replaces the saved one; to change the selection_ids of a saved item, quote its item_id. No other id is needed. role: PROCEDURE, GENERAL_PROCEDURE, REFERENCED_PROCEDURE, CHARACTERIZATION, COMPOUND_TITLE, FIGURE_CAPTION, NARRATIVE, OTHER.

items.description:
Deliver a complete paragraph with its role and object ownership,
without extracting isolated scientific values.

about_ids.description: Existing operation, reaction-block or compound ids this paragraph concerns; include those ids when ownership is established, including the assigned step. Empty means no specific object is established; explain that uncertainty or the genuinely paper-wide scope, rather than leaving an established attribution implicit.

explanation.description: Why this whole passage belongs to those objects and has the selected role.

item_id.description: Host-issued handle returned when this item was first saved; quote it only to change the fields that identify the item (its collection says which), and omit it for a new item.

role.description: How this paragraph serves the step: procedure, characterization, compound title, caption, narrative, or another declared role.

selection_ids.description: Delivered selection ids for the complete paragraph or passage; preserve its procedural context.

repairs.description: Optional. An accepted new version of the same item supersedes its rejected proposal; this does not prove the old scientific claim was saved. To declare a correction/replacement explicitly, give the rejected row's action_id and the corrected item's key in this write, spelled as receipts spell item: collection:index for a listed item, or the envelope's own name.

items.description: Two keys copied from receipts: the rejected row's action_id, the corrected item's item.

action_id.description: Copy the action_id of the rejected row from the receipt that listed it. The host assigns action_ids to receipt rows; items carry none.

item.description: The corrected item's key in this write, spelled as receipts spell item: collection:index for a listed item, or the envelope's own name.
